Method generate_package()

Generate the R package.

Usage

Generator$generate_package(
  path,
  package_name,
  author = "Package Author",
  email = "author@example.com",
  license_holder = paste(package_name, "authors")
)

Arguments

path

The output directory path.

package_name

The name of the package to generate.

author

The package author name for DESCRIPTION.

email

The package maintainer email for DESCRIPTION.

license_holder

The copyright holder name for LICENSE.
